title: Geopolitical Daily
preheader: Rescuers race to find 3,000 missing as another landslide dam threatens to burst.
intro_text: Good morning. It's Sunday, August 30, 2026 — one story worth your full attention today, plus 7 quick updates from around the world.

stories.story_title: Nepal-Tibet Flood Death Toll Nearly Doubles, 3,000 Still Missing
stories.why_important: The confirmed death toll jumped from around 359 to at least 682 in just days. Nepal now says 3,000 people are still missing, more than double earlier estimates. Rescuers are also racing to save hydropower workers trapped in flooded tunnels as a landslide dam threatens fresh flooding.
stories.what_overlooked: Little coverage explains why an upstream landslide dam could trigger a second wave of flooding before rescue teams finish their work.
stories.prediction: Watch for whether the landslide dam breaches, which could send a new flood surge downstream within days.
sources: https://www.sixthtone.com/news/1018953/Hundreds Still Missing After Deadly China-Nepal Border Mudslide

quick_hits.text: A Russian drone strike on an ammo depot near Kyiv killed at least 37 people, including care home residents.
Mutinying soldiers clashed with troops near Niger's presidential palace before the junta said it regained control.
Venezuela's interim president says the country keeps 'sovereignty' despite a deal sending $19 a barrel to the US.
Putin, Xi and Iran's Pezeshkian head to Kyrgyzstan for a two-day Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit.
North Korea dismissed and demoted its defense minister, naming Kim Song Gi as replacement, state media says.
Icelanders voted 'no' by 52.5% on reopening EU membership talks, despite Trump's threats toward Greenland.
B'Tselem says Israeli forces and settlers have killed 235 children in the West Bank since October 2023.

big_number.context: Palestinian children killed by Israeli forces or settlers in the West Bank since October 2023, a rights group reports.
